title: Purified FPS
description: A light weight modpack that aims to improve minecraft performance.
body:
Purified FPS is a collection of optimization mods designed to boost FPS, reduce stutter, and speed up loading — all while keeping the game’s look and feel completely vanilla. Perfect for both low-end and high-end PCs, this pack focuses purely on performance so you can enjoy smoother gameplay without extra clutter.

Minimum RAM allocated: 2GB
